draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.23, the 78th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 5th of 14 at QB. He went 68th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Desmond Ridder. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 3,135 passing yards in 2022, 9th of 14 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Tennessee Titans (practice squad). 3 career games and 0 starts over 1 completed season. Still developing: 0 AV in 2024. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (1st percentile). Played 3 of 17 games in 2024. Versus the typical Year-2 quarterback who played: 62 passing yards against a median of 1,765, below the norm.
